cues.text: A massive gas giant looms in the starry void. Its deep red atmosphere churns with fierce, glowing orange bands of heat along one horizon.
Nearby, a brilliant cyan nebula glows in the dark space beyond a small, barren moon.
A tiny point of light, the colony ship, streaks across the dark face of the giant. It leaves a faint trail as it glides past the fiery atmosphere to enter orbit.

beats.note: A massive, dark red gas giant dominates the left side of space. Its right edge glows with fiery orange bands.
To the right, a bright cyan nebula glows in the background. A small moon sits between the nebula and the gas giant.
A tiny white speck, the colony ship, enters from the left and moves across the dark face of the gas giant.
The ship crosses the glowing orange terminator line and continues to the right, passing above the moon.
